The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

I was travelling with sight impaired friends Assistance was prebooked with Easyjet I cannot praise the staff highly enough We arrived late at night and we were wheeled very efficiently and cheerfully The staff cared for us very well and made sure we got safely to our taxi

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect

Whats not to like about DFW You can park at any terminal and take the SkyLink to whichever terminal youre departing from Departure from Terminal E and arrival at Terminal A Parked across from Terminal E United Airlines gates TSAPre took a little bit longer than usual to clear minutes Both Terminals A E are spacious with plenty of shops and dining options Terminals were clean

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines
Once again I used Lviv Airport four times in August Very satisfied with facilities and staff who work there Definitely beats many USA airport who have a lot to do in order to improve

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems

Whats not to like about TF Green Airport It was recently ranked the d best airport by Travel Leisure readers Its newly remodeled bathrooms are like those of a star hotel Going through TSAPre was a breeze Cleared security in less than minutes Distances from security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly This used to be my home airport before I relocated to the Dallas area and it remains one of my favorite airports to fly through

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments
Riyadh airport is a nice airport We had to transit from there and were surprised to see that how beautiful is even their domestic terminal

This little airport is very nice and adapted to the demand and number of passengers There was only one cafe but with nice food and drinks Because of the small numbers of passengers traveling through that airport there was absolutely no waiting I would defenitly go there again

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges
The best assistance so far for arrival and departure For someone who has less mobility and needs a wheel chair Superb and faster assistance Everything in place on time

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

From the city to the airport in minutes The new terminal is fine Beautiful geometric lines used in the design Checkin for flight did not take too long The old building renovated and converted into a zone of local flights There are many shops and cafes There was a small queue of precontrol before departure

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

Haneda is a nice airport but immigration is hell long lines clearly show the Japanese slowness to adapt to any increase of the of arrival If you fly in while low traffic It is one of the best airport but not today as I will be losing minutes to pass immigration
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board
A decent enough job on a very full flight They got me there from A to B without frills or fuss I liked the onboard Kiwi Qui that they ran during the flight a nice and quirky touch

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight

From the moment I boarded the crew exuded warmth and professionalism Junu and Reeza provided assistance wherever needed The inflight service was impeccable Bhoomi and Nisha managed the meal service efficiently The crew went above and beyond to ensure passenger comfort Whether it was providing extra blankets assisting with luggage or attending to special requests they were attentive and proactive Their kindness and willingness to help truly stood out Looking forward to flying with Akasa Air again

AMSAUAAMS I regularly fly ArkeFly between Europe and the Antilles and what a huge difference between the old and worn with barely enough space to breathe and the new with more spacious seats PTV and a so much better experience Furthermore the crew seems to enjoy the Dreamliner much more and even smiles are being made Also the time of always being delayed also seems to be over ArkeFly improved a lot with the Dreamliner and I even prefer Arkefly above KLM now as long as they fly the Dreamliner
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air and I found this airline to be brilliant in all aspects Their prices are phenomenal and I couldnt complain about anything Check in was super fast and done with a smile The plane is a little outdated but its still new and growing The flight itself was mins and for such a short flight you even got a complimentary drink

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience

FCOTSRIAS Business Class Checkin in FCO terrible just counter minutes waiting time No lounge offered Inflight service with very friendly and attentive staff good food Transit in TSR as well despite of being a small and old airport was ok Here again very polite staff

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

Its nothing too special but it was definitely an affordable price The inflight food and beverage was comprised of a juice box and bottled water The customer service is ok There was in issue with the website where it continually declined my card but it actually charged my card every time I attempted meaning with four attempts there were in false charges Fortunately the customer service could be reached by WhatsApp and they were able to refund me for the imaginary flight bookings

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

I took GOL twice for domestic flights during a recent trip to Brazil I chose the extra legroom seats which were available for a reasonable surcharge and offered plenty of legroom Overall the flights were comfortable and on time All passengers were offered a small snack and a drink I would choose GOL again

Apart from a minute delay outbound it is hard to fault my SydneyAdelaide return trip Yes its a no frills carrier but most everything worked efficiently and I was impressed by how smiling and happy all the staff were

I want to express my sincere thanks to Jin Air staff in Osaka I had a flight from Osaka to Seoul in May and had not completed the Keta for this reason I could not board However the checkin staff did everything possible to help me complete the documentation Despite not having completed it on time I missed my flight even so the staff offered me an available seat on the next flight I really value this collaboration I hope the staff is notified about this Thank you so much

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

Superb This is by far the best business class product within Europe The meal was one of the best Ive eaten Cabin crew delightful Wine servings enormous and just nothing to correct in the product It is a shame that no other European airline comes close to this standard

A comfortable nononsense flight which was delayed by about minutes while departing but made up for most of the time difference by the time one landed The crew was courteous and professional the seating comfortable and there was a snack service consisting of a packet of Lays Chips and a Juice which was quite ok for the short flight The luggage arrival was also fuss free and ontime Overall quite a nice flight

TIPBEN on a nearly new Canadair regional jet with leather seats and decent pitch Very happy with the short flight New terminals are being built at both ends sorely needed Otherwise would fly them again

We took Flight from Kathmandu to Bangkok by Nepal airlines for our Holiday trip Flight was on time meal provided during flight is delicious and have veg and non veg options Staff of airline were well behaved and professional I will use service of Nepal in future as well Highly recommended

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

I work on a consumer programme for ITV and would be interested in hearing from anyone who was on the Phuket Air flight which had a reported fuel leak during a routine stop at Sharjah on Sunday rd April We would be interested in hearing your story Please send your contact details using the Comment Form at the bottom of this page and Skytrax will put you in touch with Sarah

Manchester to Tenerife On the morning of our flight TUI informed us that due to scheduling issues they have enlisted Privilege style as a charter airline The seat was comfortable only issues were my tray table was loose the window was in a position that caused pain on my neck to look out of it The interior felt somewhat tired Apart from this the flight was comfortable and landed safely

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Tambor to San Jos Regional airline Flight with Cessna clean and flight was on time Very basic airport but the staff were eager to operate it efficient They operate from San Jos domestic terminal which is basic but does the job They are trustworthy and I would recommend them

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Pricequality is unbeatable Airplane was on the same standard as most European Airlines and Food and service as well Regarding the transfer in Shenzhen it works perfectly It is a huge modern international Airport I was advised that I could enjoy my time outside the aiport as Austria is one of EU countries that are now Visa free Went to the city with public transport and visited the KK Mall and St Regis Highly recommended Plane was empty that was nice as well

I recently flew in Singapore airlines Everything about the airline is premium Check in experience the gate allotted to them time performance crew Flying in A was itself unique experience Seating comfort could have been better though otherwise its a out of

This airline is world class and knows how to treat its customers with professionalism and respect Hands down the best airline Ive traveled with and Ive traveled a lot If their standards remain top notch Ill be a customer for life

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional

I have read many negative reviews about this airline so I was not disappointed There was absolutely no service no water was offered no entertainment seats were standard but could not be reclined Checkin was efficient as well as boarding and the most positive point was that the plane left and arrived on time Given the price it was a reasonable option

KIXHND a stylish airline Cabin staff service efficient Cabin which is coordinated in white and black elegant and personal monitor is easy to use Seats are made of black leather and seat pitch is enough
This airline has impressive cabin staff and a very efficient ground staff never need check in more than minutes before my flight even in Tokyo

My route was GUASALLAX and I like the attention and polite service of the flight attendants During the flight GUASAL operated by E we had candies and the departure and arrival to SAL was on time The service from SAL LAX operated by A and we departed on time The crew were very nice We got our dinner and a movie before the purser shut off the lights to let us sleep and they offered blankets For passengers that didnt sleep the crew offered beverages
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

CPHHurghadaCPH Flew this airline as part of a charter flightholiday in the Red Sea Both flights I enjoyed immensely Credit for this goes to the cabin crew and their ability to generate such a happy atmosphere in cabin The food quality served was by far the best I have put my teeth into for economy class in more than years of flying around the world On top of this the plane was literally an all new A I had paid a little extra for a few extra centimetres of leg space thumbs up arrival on time at both ends

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight

I was really impressed with V Air flying from Bangkok to Taipei Easy to use website for booking Smiling staff at check in Very efficient even weighed and tagged cabin baggage Flight lifted off at exact departure time Plane seemed new We didnt preorder food but were able to buy some Cabin crew did a delightful safety demonstration smiling graciously and the passengers applauded Everything spotless efficient thoughtful

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale

The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

I was travelling with sight impaired friends Assistance was prebooked with Easyjet I cannot praise the staff highly enough We arrived late at night and we were wheeled very efficiently and cheerfully The staff cared for us very well and made sure we got safely to our taxi

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect

Whats not to like about DFW You can park at any terminal and take the SkyLink to whichever terminal youre departing from Departure from Terminal E and arrival at Terminal A Parked across from Terminal E United Airlines gates TSAPre took a little bit longer than usual to clear minutes Both Terminals A E are spacious with plenty of shops and dining options Terminals were clean

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines
Once again I used Lviv Airport four times in August Very satisfied with facilities and staff who work there Definitely beats many USA airport who have a lot to do in order to improve

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems

Whats not to like about TF Green Airport It was recently ranked the d best airport by Travel Leisure readers Its newly remodeled bathrooms are like those of a star hotel Going through TSAPre was a breeze Cleared security in less than minutes Distances from security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly This used to be my home airport before I relocated to the Dallas area and it remains one of my favorite airports to fly through
